name: EPIC 220341512
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 6.8 solar radii and 0.92 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220341512 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.83754 (16th-84th percentiles 6.65161-7.069731), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220341512 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.920488 (16th-84th percentiles 0.86032-0.998889), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220341512: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4661.742 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220341512 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2209.550781 (16th-84th percentiles 2154.746094-2270.976562), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.07 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,210 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.92 solar masses and 6.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,662 K at its surface.
